issues.whole_packet_no_support: absence of consideration for the distinct contexts of fisheries debates and school meal provision
issues.mechanism: Ignoring temporal and thematic differences between the debates
issues.material_consequence: The claim falsely presents a unified discourse without acknowledging the separate issues being addressed.
issues.counterconditions: Acknowledging the different subject matter of the excerpts does not negate the possibility of contextual differences within each debate.

review.rationale: The excerpts present distinct debates – one on fisheries and another on school meals – and the claim asserts no meaningful contextual differences, failing to recognize the separate contexts and issues being discussed.
